name: Inventory
descriptor: Items and their movements: a signed quantity per movement, a balance per item, and a reorder flag when it runs low.
verify_checks: balance: the balance maths is emitted
balance: the reorder flag is emitted
pros: the balance is derived, so it can never disagree with the movements
a movement is signed, so receipts and issues are the same kind of record
the reorder flag turns the list into a worklist
the parent read view shows the history that produced the number
cons: the balance is recomputed on every render, which is fine at hundreds of movements and not at hundreds of thousands
no valuation: quantities only, no price per movement
no lot numbers, no expiry dates, no locations
deleting a movement changes history with no audit trail
best_for: a small store room where the count must match the movements
avoid_if: you need valuation, lots, or an audit trail
